cohort: Mothers with children aged <2 years old in Abu Dhabi, U.A.E.
finding: Approximately four out of ten mothers delayed initiation of breastfeeding for more than one hour after delivery, with factors associated with delayed breastfeeding initiation being non-Arab nationality, caesarean section, non-rooming-in, first birth order, and mothers with low-birth-weight children.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding (AOR 2.85, 95% CI 2.26, 3.58).
